# MIZ OKI
> Governed decision system for performance marketing and commerce: anticipatory intent with proof of causal lift, iROAS-driven budget decisions, and an autonomy ladder whose promotion gates are fixed and human-decided.

Capability statements on this site carry LIVE / PARTIAL / IN BUILD / PROPOSED / ROADMAP labels; every performance figure carries a truth label (verified / benchmark / pilot / design target / illustrative).

## Product

- [Signal](https://mizoki3.com/signal): the Shopify-merchant growth control surface — thresholds, budget, creative, audiences, measurement.
- [Signal thresholds](https://mizoki3.com/signal/thresholds): threshold-aware decisions.
- [Signal budget](https://mizoki3.com/signal/budget): iROAS-driven reallocation.
- [Signal creative](https://mizoki3.com/signal/creative): creative decisions under the same gates.
- [Signal audiences](https://mizoki3.com/signal/audiences): audience decisions with holdouts.
- [Signal measurement](https://mizoki3.com/signal/measurement): incrementality over platform attribution.
- [Shopify](https://mizoki3.com/shopify): the Shopify-merchant homepage.
- [Pricing](https://mizoki3.com/pricing): packaging and the 90-Day Growth Control Pilot.

## Demos

- [Demo hub](https://mizoki3.com/demo): guided demo surfaces.
